description: The individual assembles, installs and maintains sanitary fittings and fixtures, sewage and drainage systems, heating and sanitary systems, gas and water pipe lines etc. Responsible for installation, operation and repair of plumbing system used in housing, commercial and institutional setups, drills passage holes in walls or floor of premises and fixes necessary brackets, stands, holders etc., maintenance and servicing of pipes and sanitary fixtures.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Identify and comply with the safe working practices, environmental regulation and housekeeping.
Identify different tools, equipments, and fittings for plumbing.
Identify basic electrical components, simple sensors in plumbing work and prepare electrical wire joints.
Test and measure equipments in plumbing.
Interpret plumbing system and plumbing terminology.
Read the plumbing drawings.
Interpret water distribution system and demonstration of water meter.
Install and maintain pressure in boosting pumps.
Reduce water wastage and increase water efficiency.
Identify, select and perform cutting of Pipes.
Carry out joining, fitting and laying of different types of PVC Pipes.
Install, fix and maintain different taps, valves, etc.
Perform different types of faucets, water closet and its repair.
Carry out testing of water pressure in plumbing system.
Install, fix and maintain sanitary ware systems and their components.
Install, fix and maintain kitchen sink, wash basin, bathtub, etc.
Perform rainwater, gray water harvesting and conservation.
Carry out repairing and maintenance of plumbing system.
Construct various brick bond for inspection chamber, ventilation provided to arrest foul gas with various traps.
Prepare and maintain the records of plumbing system.
Install, calibrate, respond and schedule a smart water meter, smart leak detector and automated irrigation system.
Workshop Calculation & Science 30 Hours
Engineering Drawing 30 Hours
Employability Skills 120 Hours
On the Job Training (OJT) (150 Hours for 1 year trades)

verticalPathName: Plumber, Senior Plumber, Supervisor, Manager, Entrepreneur
